_provenance.purpose: Daily food-group reference targets in USDA Food Pattern equivalent units, for computing 'gap vs guideline' on FPED-aggregated meals/days.
_provenance.myplate_source: USDA & HHS. Dietary Guidelines for Americans 2020-2025, Appendix 3 (Healthy U.S.-Style Dietary Pattern at 2000 kcal). Weekly subgroup amounts divided by 7 for daily equivalents.
_provenance.cfg_source: Health Canada. Canada's Food Guide 2019 (plate model). CFG-2019 dropped numeric servings in favour of plate proportions (half vegetables & fruits, quarter whole grains, quarter protein foods, water as the drink of choice), so the cfg2019_approx values are DERIVED cup/oz-equivalent approximations of those proportions at ~2000 kcal, NOT official Health Canada serving numbers.
caveats: MyPlate/DGA targets are US reference amounts; they are unit-matched to FPED (cup/oz/tsp equivalents) and to NHANES/HEI literature, but are a US guideline applied to a Canadian-anchored platform.
CFG-2019 values are an approximation of the plate model in FPED units, with no official numeric backing; treat as directional, not authoritative.
Targets assume ~2000 kcal/day; they are not energy-adjusted to the individual's intake in v1.

Food Pattern equivalents are borrowed from each food's closest US analog (neither CNF nor WAFCT publishes them natively); most reliable for foods with a close US match, least reliable for region-specific dishes, which are left out when no analog exists.
